# QuickSend transfer core

Source: https://github.com/esleeeeee/eslee-quick-send
Revision: `230808fd75554efafd3f2388947c703300224603`

These files are vendored from the user's existing QuickSend project for the requested MeshDrive integration. ReceiverSession, chunk SHA-256, Merkle completion, checkpoint persistence and collision handling are reused without requiring a separate QuickSend installation. The HTTPS adapter lives in MeshDrive.Agent. No QuickSend GUI, credentials or user data are copied.

The source repository has no standalone LICENSE file at this revision. Ownership is shared with this project; no third-party relicensing is asserted. Review the upstream license before redistributing independently.
